body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> At the 2008 CES, WirelessHD announced that the new WirelessHD specification will provide consumers with seamless, wireless connectivity between digital source devices including, DVD players, portable games, digital cameras, digital A/V players, personal computers and digital video recorders and their HDTVs, allowing users to quickly and easily share content between devices without the confusion of cables.

According to John Marshall, Chairman of WirelessHD, WirelessHD experienced a successful introduction at CES this year and has established itself as the choice of major global consumer electronics manufacturers for delivery of true uncompressed, lossless delivery of high definition content.
